title: Stocks Lack a Key Catalyst Today
summary: “Anyone available to play golf today? I have an extra spot in my 2:20 foursome.” - a message in a group chat this morning...These are the days when those of us on the equity side of the business are envious of our friends in the bond market. They get to take off on federal holidays like Columbus Day, when the banking system, and hence the bond market, are closed yet equities are open . Normally, that’s not much of an inconvenience, even if I’d rather take up my friend on his offer. Lately though, stocks have been taking many cues from bonds, leaving them somewhat adrift this morning.
